body.x: NAMUTECH (CEO Chul Jung) showcased its digital conversion platform Cocktail Cloud 4.0 at the CES 2020, the world's largest IT and electronics show held in Las Vegas on January 7-10.

Cocktail Cloud 4.0 is a digital platform(PaaS) that enables companies to use the cloud-native platform forimplementation. It was based on the experience of building multi cloud, AI, andsmart city building experience.

With the cloud platform made of specializedapplication, it has demonstrated a high level of technological prowess inglobal competition in US, Japan, and China. And, it is solidifying its positionby advancing big data and AI technologies.

This allows companies to efficiently managetheir servers and cloud infrastructure by integrating public clouds such asAmazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) intheir private clouds.

Cocktail Cloud was proven its technologicalcapabilities by passing the Certified Kubernetes Conformance Program run byCloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) for the first time in Korea in thecloud product sector.

CEO Jung said, “With the big companies, finance, telecommunications, and public references, we are becoming a competitive company in cloud platform market. We would like to become the data hub for AI, smart city, and blockchain by advancing the technology.”

NAMUTECH (www.namutech.co.kr), thecloud-based integrated solution company, was founded on November 11, 2001. Byfocusing on the virtualization market, it has acquired various implementationachievements and patents.

NAMUTECH provides a wide range of products,including self-developed hybrid cloud platform Cocktails Cloud and also the virtualizationsolution NCC (Namu Cloud Center), Citrix, Dell Technologies, and Google CloudPlatform to the market.

The world’s largest IT show CES shows thetrend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted byConsumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
